headline: Transferred Someone Else's Card, You Could Go to Prison: Rada Supports New Rules for "Drops"
summary: Ukraine's parliament approved new fines and prison terms for 'drops', or money mules, who transfer other people's cards. A lawyer said the rules carry risks for bank and business clients.
why: Money mule schemes move proceeds of fraud through bank accounts, so tougher rules affect banks' compliance obligations. Investors monitor financial-crime regulation for its effect on the banking sector.
